official_measurement_examples.name: First Homes minimum discount
official_measurement_examples.fact: National First Homes policy describes a minimum 30% discount from market value, with the discount secured for future qualifying purchasers through planning and title mechanisms.

official_measurement_examples.name: Section 106 mechanism
official_measurement_examples.fact: First Homes restrictions are normally secured through section 106 obligations and title restrictions; policy identification alone is not a delivered First Home.

official_measurement_examples.name: Exception-site distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: First Homes exception sites and rural exception sites are distinct policy routes and must not be treated as interchangeable site categories.

official_measurement_examples.name: Rural exception purpose
official_measurement_examples.fact: Rural exception sites are small sites used for affordable housing to meet local community needs where housing would not normally be permitted.

official_measurement_examples.name: Market housing proportion
official_measurement_examples.fact: A limited proportion of market housing can be considered on rural exception sites where necessary to facilitate affordable delivery; this is not a blanket market-housing allocation.

official_measurement_examples.name: Affordable housing definition
official_measurement_examples.fact: Affordable housing comprises defined tenures and eligibility mechanisms in the NPPF glossary; the label does not itself prove legal affordability controls are secured.

official_measurement_examples.name: Policy versus permission
official_measurement_examples.fact: Affordable housing or First Homes policy support does not itself grant planning permission, prove viability or guarantee unit delivery.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Affordable housing policy status does not establish parcel ownership exact buildable area access infrastructure capacity or final development yield.

core_rules: First Homes policy is not planning permission
First Homes exception site is distinct from rural exception site
section106 template is not executed obligation
discount policy is not delivered title restriction
affordable definition is not parcel allocation
rural exception evidence must be local-need specific
market housing on exception sites is not automatic
Green Belt and designated-rural rules require current policy check
planning obligation is distinct from ownership
viability evidence is distinct from permission
policy support is not infrastructure capacity
affordable housing does not calculate parcel yield
historic policy must retain temporal context
no parcel affordable-housing clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
